solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 2'** i.e. **'Sieze'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The incorrectly spelled word is** Sieze.**
 
• The correct spelling is** "Seize."**
 
• Explanation of the **correct meanings:**
 
 
• **Believe: **To accept something as true or real, to have faith or confidence in something or someone. (विश्वास करना)
 
• **Seize: **To take hold of something forcibly, to grab or capture. (पकड़ना)
 
• **Receive:** To be given or presented with something, to accept or get something. (प्राप्त करना)
 
• **Relieve:** To alleviate or lessen something, to provide comfort or assistance, to remove or reduce a burden or stress. (राहत देना)
 
 

Therefore, the** correct answer** is:** 'Sieze'.**
